purpose: Teach: 集結/論評/開館/取り込む/愛称/利率/換金/代弁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会で同分野の研究者が集結するぞ
lines.en: Ren, researchers from the same field will all be gathered at the conference.
lines.style: Calm, direct instruction. Lean forward slightly on the speaker's name. Measured pace. This is opportunity, not burden—delivered with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の論評を予習しております
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've been preparing by reviewing the papers beforehand.
lines.style: Alert, eager to please. Quick intake of breath before speaking. Clipped, precise delivery—the words of someone who has already begun the work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究施設の新棟の開館式に出ろ
lines.en: Ren, attend the opening ceremony for the new research facility wing.
lines.style: Direct assignment. Steady tone, no inflection that softens the instruction. This is a task, clearly stated. Brief pause after the name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指摘事項を研究計画に取り込む努力をします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll make sure to incorporate any feedback into the research plan.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Slower pacing than before—he's thinking while speaking. Soft trailing-off at the end, showing he's already mentally organizing the work ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究プロジェクトの愛称を考えろ
lines.en: Ren, come up with a working title for the research project.
lines.style: Curt, expectant. No softness—this is a directive, not a suggestion. Weight on 'come up with,' as if testing whether Ren can think beyond just execution.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の利率優遇制度を活用いたします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll take advantage of the preferential interest rate system for research funding.
lines.style: Over-eager, slightly off-pitch. He's answering what he thinks he heard, not what was asked. Faster than natural, the rush of someone proving his competence before listening fully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外助成の換金手続を学習しろ
lines.en: Ren, learn the procedures for converting overseas grants into usable funds.
lines.style: Final instruction, delivered with weight. Steady eye-line. Emphasis on 'learn the procedures'—this is practical knowledge, not academic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究意義を学会で代弁いたします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll represent the research and its significance at the conference.
lines.style: Closing affirmation, formal and complete. Full breath before speaking. Slight relief in the tone—relief of having received clear direction. Controlled, dignified ending.
